title: Sheherazaad’s Khudgarzi is gorgeous, ‘genre-chaotic’ South Asian folk
description: Sheherazaad started making ripples in the music world a few years ago with her EP Qasr, which was produced by Grammy Award winner Arooj Aftab. Now she's back with Khudgarzi, her reverb-drenched folk-noir debut LP that's primarily sung in Urdu. The instrumentation on Khudgarzi draws on traditional South Asian music, including Carnatic and Hindustani styles, […]
